trĕchĕdīpnum , i, n. (sc. vestimentum), = τρεχέδειπνον (running to a banquet),
I.a light garment worn at table by parasites, Juv. 3, 67 (trechedipna vestimenta parasitica currentium ad cenam, Schol.).
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
